Give the warm dry evening its own arrival source — spawnEveningAgent() under its own EVE_CAP, never a share of laneCap or eastCap — open from sunDown − 0.5 h to sunDown + 3 h when warmth is high, it is not raining, wetF() is low and windF() is below a stroll threshold; closed in winter. They enter by the park gate or the quay head, cross the FOOTBRIDGE (DECK_LEAD_A/Q, the #73 routes), lean at the rail (a.nightRail exists as ONE stander — widen it or give the deck its own lean spots), sit on the quay/far benches, and leave the way they came or via goHome/claimHome before the window's end (price with pathHours() against the END, the #53 law). An 80–150-line diff is expected.
